verdict.rationale: Atlas offers a narrow, controlled document workflow: SAFEs can be created, sent, and tracked from the Dashboard instead of over email. It also provides Cooley-developed legal templates and a Documents tab for incorporation documents. This covers drafting and sending for a few startup-specific documents, not general contract lifecycle management. Missing for 10: negotiation workflow, redlining/version comparison, support for arbitrary contract types, approval routing, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of contract workflow use.
